mapper.insert: INSERT INTO odin_atlas_task_instance_lineage_nodes ( guid, instance_guid, node_name, is_source ) VALUES ( #{guid}, #{instanceGuid}, #{nodeName}, #{source} )
mapper.select: SELECT instance_node.`guid`, instance_node.`instance_guid`, instance_node.`node_name`, instance_node.`is_source` FROM `odin_atlas_task_instance_lineage_nodes` AS instance_node JOIN `hydra_task_instances` AS task_instance ON task_instance.`guid` = instance_node.`instance_guid` WHERE task_instance.`task_guid` = #{taskGuid} AND task_instance.`expect_time` = #{expectTime} LIMIT 1
